explanation: Matches the ordinal version of erdosproblems.com/118 with the negative answer of Schipperus and Darby: it is not true that every ordinal α with α → (α, 3)² also satisfies α → (α, n)² for all finite n ≥ 3. The local OrdinalRamsey predicate (red clique of type β or blue clique of type γ) is the standard arrow. Restricting to ordinals is the natural reading, and Larson's ω^{ω²} is an ordinal counterexample.
